paite: Ka phat Pathian aw, dai nilouh ke’n;
heading: David phatna La / Ami Lungzing Phunna
english: For the Chief Musician. A Psalm by David. God of my praise, don’t remain silent,

paite: Migilou-salou kam leh kam khemhat ka tung ah ahangsan ngal ua; amau lei zuauthei in ka kiang ah thu agen uhi.
english: for they have opened the mouth of the wicked and the mouth of deceit against me. They have spoken to me with a lying tongue.

paite: Huatna thu in ahon umsuak ua, bangmah lou in hon dou uhi.
english: They have also surrounded me with words of hatred, and fought against me without a cause.

paite: Ka it ziak in hon doute ahong hita uh; himahleh kei zaw thumthum ding in ka kipe tinten hi.
english: In return for my love, they are my adversaries; but I am in prayer.

paite: Amau thil hoih thil gilou in ahon thuk ua, ka itna huatna mah in ahon thuk uhi.
english: They have rewarded me evil for good, and hatred for my love.

paite: Nang atung ah migilou koih inla; ataklam ah hekmi dingh hen.
english: Set a wicked man over him. Let an adversary stand at his right hand.

paite: Vai hawmsak a a-om chiang in siam louh tang in pawt henla; athumna khelhna ah suak hen.
english: When he is judged, let him come out guilty. Let his prayer be turned into sin.

paite: Adamsung nite tom henla; aheutu hihna midang in tang hen.
english: Let his days be few. Let another take his office.

paite: Atate pa lou in om uhenla, azi mah leng meithai in om hen.
english: Let his children be fatherless, and his wife a widow.

paite: Atate mivakvai hong hi in, khut doh uhenla; anek ding uh amun gamsiate ah zong uhen.
english: Let his children be wandering beggars. Let them be sought from their ruins.

paite: Apung delh a dangka leitawisak in aneih tengteng laksak vek henla; mikhualte'n asepgim gah lok uhen.
english: Let the creditor seize all that he has. Let strangers plunder the fruit of his labor.

paite: Atung a zahngaihna langsak zel ding kuamah om sam kei uhenla; ata pa neiloute hehpihpa ding kuamah om kei hen.
english: Let there be no one to extend kindness to him, neither let there be anyone to have pity on his fatherless children.

paite: Asuante hihman in om uh henla; khangthak hong om nawn ah amin uh nulmang in om hen.
english: Let his posterity be cut off. In the generation following let their name be blotted out.

paite: Apipute uh gitlouh satlouhna TOUPA kiang ah theihgige in om henla; anu khelhna nulmang in om kei hen.
english: Let the iniquity of his fathers be remembered by Yahweh. Don’t let the sin of his mother be blotted out.

paite: TOUPA ma ah om gige hen. Ama'n amau theihgigena lei a kipan ahihmang theihna ding in.
english: Let them be before Yahweh continually, that he may cut off their memory from the earth;

paite: Zahngaihna latsakna dan atheih louh ua, migenthei, tagah leh khasiate thah tum a asawi zawk ziak un.
english: because he didn’t remember to show kindness, but persecuted the poor and needy man, the broken in heart, to kill them.

paite: Ahi, mi hamsiat a-utlam ahi a, huchi in amah tung ah ahong tung a; mi vualzawl akipah lam ahi kei a, huchi in amah gamlat in a-om hi.
english: Yes, he loved cursing, and it came to him. He didn’t delight in blessing, and it was far from him.

paite: Puanak tual silh bang in hamsiatna in akivan a, huai agilsung ah tui bang in alut a, aguhte ah thau bang in aluanglut hi.
english: He clothed himself also with cursing as with his garment. It came into his inward parts like water, like oil into his bones.

paite: Huai amah a ding in silh gige puansilh bang in om henla, akigak zelna kawnggak mah leng hi hen.
english: Let it be to him as the clothing with which he covers himself, for the belt that is always around him.

paite: Huai hon doute leh ka hinna gensete TOUPA'N athukna ahi.
english: This is the reward of my adversaries from Yahweh, of those who speak evil against my soul.

paite: Himahleh, TOUPA Pathian aw, nang na min ziak in hon hehpih inla; na zahngaihna ahoih ziak in hon humbit in.
english: But deal with me, Yahweh the Lord, for your name’s sake, because your loving kindness is good, deliver me;

paite: Genthei leh tagahtak ka hi a, ka lungtang ka gilsung ah liam in a-om ngal a.
english: for I am poor and needy. My heart is wounded within me.

paite: Liim kiam lam bang in ka mang a; khaupe bang in mutleng in ka om hi.
english: I fade away like an evening shadow. I am shaken off like a locust.

paite: Ka khukte an ngawl ziak in ahatta kei a; ka sa in thau himhim aputa kei hi.
english: My knees are weak through fasting. My body is thin and lacks fat.

paite: Amau gensiat ka na hita a; hon muh un alu uh asing uhi.
english: I have also become a reproach to them. When they see me, they shake their head.

paite: TOUPA ka Pathian aw, hon panpih inla; aw na zahngaihna bang zel in hon hondam in;
english: Help me, Yahweh, my God. Save me according to your loving kindness;

paite: Huai na khut ahi, achih theih ua, TOUPA, nang na hih ahi, chih atheihna ding un.
english: that they may know that this is your hand; that you, Yahweh, have done it.

paite: Amau hamsiat uhen, nang zaw vualzawl zaw in; athohtak un azahlak ding ua, na sikha in bel nuam asa ding hi.
english: They may curse, but you bless. When they arise, they will be shamed, but your servant shall rejoice.

paite: Hon doute zumna puan silhsak in om uhenla, puanak a kivan bang in amau zahlakna in kivan uhen.
english: Let my adversaries be clothed with dishonor. Let them cover themselves with their own shame as with a robe.

paite: Ka kam in TOUPA kiang ah kipahthu nakpi in ka gen dia; ahi, mipi lak ah amah ka phat ding hi.
english: I will give great thanks to Yahweh with my mouth. Yes, I will praise him among the multitude.

paite: Amah tagahte taklam ah adingh a, hinna vai hawmsakte lak a hondam ding in.
english: For he will stand at the right hand of the needy, to save him from those who judge his soul.
